articles.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
articles.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

articles.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
articles.summary: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

articles.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
articles.summary: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites and build proposals, while proactively flagging messages and resolving issues.

OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
articles.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

articles.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
articles.summary: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.
